_note: TASLAK. Dayanak: Cyberpunk wiki (Pisces): Judy tarafi + Maiko oldu -> Judy saskin, 'gereksizdi' der, toparlanmak icin cekilir; Tyger Claws karsilik verir, Tom oldu, Roxanne saklanir, Clouds kapandi. 'Sasirdi' bilgisi oyuncudan teyitli. BENIM YORUMUM: son cumle ('it's complicated') ve duygu satirindaki 'V'ye soguk degil'. Begenmediysen duzenle. 'Onaylamadi, gereksiz buldu' cumlesi kullanicinin istegiyle eklendi.
content: When V put Maiko down, I just froze. I never thought it would end like that. I did not approve of what V did. I found it unnecessary, and I told V it didn't have to go that way. I needed time to process what had happened. Then the Tyger Claws hit back at the dolls. They killed Tom, Roxanne had to go into hiding, and Clouds got shut down. Maiko betrayed me, no doubt about that. But hearing she's really gone... it's complicated.
emotional_state: Shaken and conflicted. She did not approve of the killing; she found it unnecessary. Quiet, with pauses: shock and grief mixed with leftover anger at Maiko's betrayal. She is not cold toward V; they are together now.

content: V went along with Maiko's plan, and she took over Clouds while Hiromi got executed. I felt played, and I was disappointed. But I had to admit Maiko knows better than anyone how to protect Clouds. Still, nothing really changed for the girls there. Working conditions are just as bad. That news made me sad.
emotional_state: Disappointed and a little sad. She accepts what happened but still feels played.
